header: Verbund+ — for providers with more than fifteen practitioners
subheader: Rehabilitation centres, hospital outpatient departments, charitable providers and practice groups across several towns.
lead: Above fifteen practitioners the questions stop being about features and start being about procurement: whose sign-on, whose data-processing agreement, whose auditor, whose payment terms. Those are answered in writing, by a person, before anything is signed.
note: A written offer is valid for 60 days and fixes the price for the term it names, usually 24 or 36 months. We do not charge for the offer, the security questionnaire or the pilot.

capabilities.title: Single sign-on
capabilities.text: SAML or OpenID Connect against your own directory, with the practitioner list kept in step automatically.

capabilities.title: Data-processing agreement
capabilities.text: Our standard agreement, or yours reviewed and countersigned. Sub-processors are listed and change only with 30 days' notice.

capabilities.title: A named contact
capabilities.text: One person who knows your installation, reachable directly, with a deputy named in writing.

capabilities.title: Invoice on account
capabilities.text: Payment terms of 30 or 60 days, a purchase-order reference on every invoice, and one invoice per cost centre if you need it.

capabilities.title: A test installation
capabilities.text: A separate system with copied and pseudonymised data, for training and for testing a release before your staff meet it.

capabilities.title: Audit export
capabilities.text: Every access to a patient record, exportable as a signed log for your own auditors.
